# Checklists

Short lists of steps that make routine work reliable. They work best when each item is a check, not a reminder of skill.

Keep a list to five to nine items and read it aloud at a pause point. A do-confirm list (do the work, then confirm) suits experienced teams; a read-do list (read each step, then do it) suits rare tasks. Plain text files are enough to keep them; see [Example checklist tool](../entities/example-checklist-tool.md).
